item.title: Construction Website Modernization and Optimization
item.description:
250-750 USD | My construction company’s website still runs on an older codebase, looks dated, and Chrome’s console is full of warnings—mostly script deprecations and Permission-Policy violations. I’m ready to give it a clean, modern and sleek facelift while also fixing every technical issue that slows it down or hurts the mobile experience.
What I need you to do • Audit the existing site, pinpoint every console error, and correct the underlying code or headers so the logs stay clean in Chrome, Firefox, and Edge. • Implement or revise the Permission-Policy header so there are no violations reported. • Redesign the front end with a contemporary, visually tight layout that keeps current content but feels fresh and professional. • Make the layout fully responsive, ensuring smooth behaviour on common breakpoints (mobile, tablet, desktop). • Optimise images, scripts, stylesheets, and server settings so Google PageSpeed Insights comfortably scores in the high 90s on both mobile and desktop. • Hand over a tested, production-ready site along with a brief summary of changes and any new dependencies.
Key notes – Design preference: modern and sleek—think generous white space, strong typography, subtle animation, and a colour palette that conveys trust. – Platform: the existing stack will be shared once you’re onboard; I’m open to fresh tooling if it shortens the build and keeps maintenance simple. – Timeline: ASAP. Please outline how quickly you can start and your estimated turnaround.
If this sounds like the kind of challenge you enjoy, let’s talk timelines and the next steps.

item.title: Custom E-Commerce Site with AliExpress
item.description:
1500-3000 USD | I need a full-featured e-commerce website built from the ground up—no Shopify, no off-the-shelf themes. A completely custom solution will give me the flexibility I need for long-term growth and brand control.
Core requirements • User accounts with secure registration, social login optional, and a simple dashboard for order history and saved items. • Product reviews and star ratings that can be moderated from the admin panel. • Fast, intuitive search with filters (price, category, rating, point value, etc.) and real-time suggestions. • Every product carries a point value that is automatically tallied at checkout; accumulated points serve as entries in an ongoing sweepstakes / prize giveaway, so the cart and account pages must display running totals clearly. • Products are sourced directly from AliExpress. They need to arrive in my catalogue via automated API calls, not manual uploads. The sync should pull images, variations, inventory counts, and pricing, and let me adjust mark-ups before publishing.
Technical expectations The stack is up to you—Laravel, Django, Node.js, or another robust framework—as long as it’s secure, performant, and documented. I’ll need: 1. A RESTful back end, cleanly structured for future mobile-app use. 2. A modern, responsive front end (React, Vue, or standard server-rendered templates—convince me). 3. AliExpress API integration or a reliable custom bridge that fetches, maps, and updates product data on a schedule I can configure. 4. Admin dashboard for catalogue, orders, users, reviews, giveaway points, and basic analytics. 5. Stripe and PayPal payment gateways to start, with room to add Klarna and Apple Pay later. 6. Deployment scripts or Docker setup so I can reproduce the environment on staging and production servers.
Acceptance criteria • Page load under 2 s on desktop (Lighthouse 90+ performance score). • AliExpress product sync runs without manual intervention and logs errors visibly. • Checkout accurately records and displays sweepstakes points. • OWASP top-10 vulnerabilities addressed; user data encrypted in transit and at rest. • Full source code in Git with commit history, plus a brief README for setup and deployment.
If this aligns with your expertise, let’s discuss timeline and phased milestones so we can launch a rock-solid store and scale from there.

item.title: E-commerce Site for Custom Wheels
item.description:
250-750 USD | I need a full-featured online store for my custom wheel and suspension business. The site’s single, overriding purpose is to sell products directly to customers, so every design and development choice must drive a seamless buying experience.
Core requirements • Product pages must carry detailed descriptions, specs, and high-resolution images so shoppers can understand offsets, finishes, and compatible suspension options before they add anything to the cart. • A smooth, reliable shopping-cart flow is essential—from “Add to cart” through order confirmation. Please integrate a secure payment gateway of your choice, but build in enough flexibility for me to switch processors later if rates change. • The catalogue will launch with roughly 60 SKUs (wheels, coilovers, lift kits), but the CMS should let me scale well into the hundreds without performance loss. • Responsive layout is non-negotiable; most of my traffic comes from mobile enthusiasts scrolling forums. • SEO-friendly URLs and schema markup for products will help us surface in “wheel size” and “suspension kit” searches. • I’ll supply branding assets and initial product data; you handle setup, theme customization or from-scratch design, and all technical configuration.
Preferred stack I’m agnostic—Shopify, WooCommerce, or another mainstream platform is fine—so recommend the one that balances long-term cost and ease of adding new product variations (bolt patterns, diameters, finishes).
Deliverables 1. Fully deployed, SSL-secured storefront on the agreed platform 2. Custom theme or branded design matching supplied style guide 3. Product database imported and verified (60 SKUs) 4. Tested shopping-cart and payment workflow (test and live modes) 5. Brief hand-off guide or video walkthrough so I can add products and run promotions myself
Acceptance criteria • A first-time visitor can land on a product page, place an item in the cart, pay, and receive an on-screen order confirmation without encountering a bug or confusing step. • Google’s PageSpeed Insights scores 85+ on mobile for the home page and a sample product page. • All core web vitals pass and no console errors appear during checkout.
Timeline is flexible within reason, but I’d like to see a working prototype two weeks after kickoff and go live within a month. Let me know your proposed platform, past e-commerce examples, and any clarifying questions.

item.title: WordPress Malware Cleanup and Migration
item.description:
250-750 AUD | My WordPress site has been compromised: visitors are being redirected to random domains, intrusive pop-ups are appearing, and I’m logging far more failed sign-in attempts than usual. I already have a fresh full backup, so you can work on a copy or restore point right away.
Here’s what I need from you: clean every trace of malware, document what was removed, close the vulnerability that allowed the breach, and then move the site to a new hosting environment without any downtime. Once migration is complete, I’ll want you to verify that the installation is still malware-free, that SSL and permalinks survived the move intact, and that performance hasn’t been impacted.
Experience recovering hacked WordPress installs is essential; your reviews should reflect successful malware removal and post-cleanup hardening. Familiarity with common security plugins, server-side scanning tools, and manual file/database inspection will help you sail through this quickly. Continuous security monitoring setup after the move would be a welcome bonus if you offer it.
Deliverables • Cleaned WordPress core, themes, and plugins with a brief report of actions taken • Hardened configuration (updated salts, strict file permissions, login protections) • Seamless migration to the new server, DNS updated, SSL functioning • Final security scan results and proof that the redirects, pop-ups, and brute-force attempts have stopped
Please outline your approach, estimated timeline, and any post-migration support you include.

250-750 AUD | EXPERIENCED web developer who can build a wholesale directory using Magento 2 Marketplace Extension. https://store.webkul.com/magento2-multi-vendor-marketplace.html
Please DO NOT bid if you do not have relevant experience or can show previous work websites. Don't tell me you are limited by NDA.

Our mission is to create exceptional homes that combine timeless elegance, innovative design, superior craftsmanship, and everyday functionality.

2. Custom Home Building Services: Showcase our ability to build beautiful custom homes tailored to each client's lifestyle, architectural preferences, and individual needs — from initial concept through final construction.
3. New Construction Homes for Sale: Feature our available new construction homes with professional photography, property descriptions, floor plans, square footage, pricing, locations, and opportunities to schedule private showings.

5. Complete Design & Build Experience: Explain our streamlined approach to residential construction, including architectural planning, design coordination, material selections, project management, construction, and final walkthroughs.
6. Exceptional Quality & Craftsmanship: Highlight our attention to detail, premium building materials, architectural features, energy-efficient construction, modern technology, and commitment to building homes that stand the test of time.
7. Communities & Service Areas: Showcase our home-building services throughout Chicago's southwest and western suburbs including Lemont, Homer Glen, Orland Park, Palos Park Burr Ridge Hinsdale and surrounding communities.
8. Interactive Floor Plans & Home Designs: Display detailed floor plans 3D architectural renderings exterior elevations and interior design concepts that help potential buyers visualize their future homes.
9. Lead Generation & Easy Communication: Make it simple for prospective customers to request consultations inquire about available properties discuss custom home projects schedule showings and contact our team. Include prominent calls to action such as Build Your Dream Home Explore Available Homes and Schedule a Consultation.
10. item.title: WordPress/Elementor Expert Needed — Fix Embedded Quote Form Without Redesign
item.description:
30-250 USD | I need an experienced WordPress/Elementor developer to fix an existing SmartMoving quote form on my business website. Currently, visitors must select a location from a dropdown menu before the quote form appears. I want to remove that dropdown and have the correct quote form load automatically on the homepage, with the SMS consent checkbox and disclosure clearly visible. This is necessary for our pending Twilio A2P SMS registration.
We have already created replacement HTML/iframe code that accomplishes this, and it works correctly in Elementor's editor preview. However, when we attempt to publish the changes, Elementor produces Server Error 500 or occasionally Server Error 403. As a result, the existing form remains unchanged on the live website.
We have spent considerable time troubleshooting this issue. Our security provider, MalCare, identified blocked WordPress requests associated with a security vulnerability in an outdated Elementor Pro installation (CVE-2024-1364). Elementor Pro is currently version 3.6.5, and attempting to update it produces the error "Download failed. Unauthorized." The original developer installed Elementor Pro, and we do not have access to their account or license. We also contacted Elementor's automated support chat without resolving the issue.
We have already updated the free Elementor plugin during troubleshooting, created and downloaded a complete website backup, established a staging website, and confirmed that the replacement form displays correctly in Elementor's preview. We also checked the regular WordPress editor and determined that the existing form is stored within Elementor's page content. Please avoid repeating troubleshooting that has already been completed unless necessary.
Our preferred solution is for an experienced developer to safely replace the existing Elementor HTML widget code using WordPress administrator or hosting-level access, bypassing Elementor's failing publishing process if necessary. This could involve modifying Elementor's stored page data or another appropriate method. We want the developer to determine the safest, simplest, and most cost-effective approach, test it on our existing staging website, and then implement it on the live website.
The required result is straightforward: remove the existing location-selection dropdown, automatically display the correct SmartMoving quote form when the homepage loads, ensure the SMS consent checkbox and disclosure are visible and functional without additional clicks, and verify that customers can successfully complete and submit the form. The finished solution must work properly on desktop and mobile, preserve the existing website design and functionality, and be verified on the public website rather than only inside the editor.
We are not looking for a complete website redesign, an Elementor Pro purchase, or extensive troubleshooting of unrelated plugins. Our immediate priority is getting this specific form working. The outdated Elementor Pro licensing and security issues can be handled separately, although any immediate security concerns should be identified. We do not want website security protections permanently disabled.
We have WordPress administrator access, GoDaddy cPanel hosting access, an existing staging website, a complete website backup, the prepared replacement form code, and screenshots documenting the errors. We do not have access to the original developer or their Elementor Pro license. The selected freelancer will receive the necessary technical information and appropriate access privately.
We prefer a small, fixed-price project with payment tied to successful completion. When applying, please briefly explain how you would implement this change without relying on the original Elementor Pro license, whether you can test on staging first, your relevant experience with Elementor or WordPress database repairs, your fixed price, and your estimated completion time.
Please communicate exclusively through Freelancer.com's messaging system. We will provide website identification, integration details, and access information privately to the selected freelancer.
Our goal is to get the existing quote form working correctly as quickly and affordably as possible so we can proceed with our Twilio A2P registration.
